Junior Coder/Tester

Example Learning Oy Helsinki, Uusimaa, Finland Hybrid Internship
Open application

About the Role

Greetings future colleagues!

We are a small edu tech startup developing a digital tool to support teachers.

We are looking for an internship candidate who can handle mainly html and Javascript, has an eye for retro visuals and bonus points if likes to sort out some math in the backend.

The candidate would support our product developer in coding and testing the browser extension version of the tool.

There is a possibility of staying with us later when we start testing and selling the product in classrooms.

Good English is a must, every other language is a bonus.

Cheers!

Apply via Email
